q1.explanationZh: 男孩说没有钥匙就关不上箱子，可他不知道钥匙在哪儿（I’ve no idea where it is）。A 太阳镜还在，他正要把它放进箱子；C 护照由爸爸保管着，没丢。

q2.explanationZh: 女人说得第一名的只是一幅从太空看地球的画（a picture of the Earth from space）。A 沙漠画是男人原以为会得奖的；B 丛林画是女人认为应该得奖的，但都没得第一。

q3.explanationZh: 中心换了新的乒乓球桌，从现在起就可以预约（from now on, you can book）。B 周六游泳池因为比赛不对公众开放；C 网球场已经订满了（fully booked）。

q4.explanationZh: 女孩要买一把尺子来替换弄坏的那把（a ruler to replace the one I broke）。A 文件夹开学第一天学校会发；C 笔在假期开始时就买好了。

q5.explanationZh: 男孩洗澡时把运动包带进了浴室，后来忘了拿出来（forgot to pick it up）。B 在门厅里的是他的围巾；C 他说不用去卧室找。

q6.explanationZh: 动物园周末关门，骑马男孩又付不起，最后女孩提议看那部关于救助动物的电影，男孩说 Let’s do that，所以去电影院。A 动物园整个周末关闭；B 骑马太贵了。

q7.explanationZh: 讲座里最有趣的职业是宇航员，Wood 老师要大家现在研究这个职业（do some research on this now）。A、C 摄影师和老师只是讲座中提到的职业。

q8.explanationZh: 女孩说和同学离开学校一起玩会很好，男孩同意，还说在大巴上和别班朋友聊天会很有趣，可见他相信会玩得开心。A 他的脚已经好了，能去；B 这个博物馆他已经去过好几次了。

q9.explanationZh: 男孩说高质量的相机是他选这款手机的主要原因（the main reason I chose this model）。A 喜欢外观的是女孩，男孩说不在乎；B 他抱怨内存不够用。

q10.explanationZh: 雷雨开始时她刚离开体育中心，就回到里面躲雨（take cover inside），等雨停了才回家。B 她并没有赶紧回家；C 她说很遗憾没看到闪电（Shame I missed seeing the lightning）。

q11.explanationZh: 男孩说现在想去哪儿都不用再让妈妈开车送，这对他是最大的变化（makes the biggest difference），说明他更独立了。A 省钱是女孩说的；C 他说还要多骑才能提高体能。

q12.explanationZh: 男孩说人物太多，要利用中场休息弄明白剧情；女孩也说很难弄清楚发生了什么（It was hard to work out what was happening），两人都觉得故事难懂。A 男孩觉得音乐增加了气氛；C 男孩觉得中场休息有帮助。

q13.explanationZh: 一个男孩说教练很少让他们为了好玩踢球，训练总是很辛苦；另一个说教练只关心怎样赢球（all about how to win matches），两人都认为教练很严肃。B 他们有了新场地；C 队服已经从灰色换成了紫色。

q14.explanationZh: 第一天上午他们参观了一座两千年前建在海边的剧院（visited a theatre）。附近的渔村只是以前有过。

q15.explanationZh: 导游没带他们去游客很多的古老宫殿，而是带他们上山参观了图书馆的遗迹（what’s left of a library）。

q16.explanationZh: 他们坐车到乡下，在一个瀑布旁吃午饭（next to a waterfall）；湖是午饭后才去的。

q17.explanationZh: 他们走进了一个叫 Flower Valley 的地方；Mosquito Valley 只是他开的玩笑。

q18.explanationZh: 第二天上午大家都选择了潜水（Everyone chose diving）；也可以滑水，但不是最受欢迎的。

q19.explanationZh: 两家工厂中，一家做锅和盘子（他觉得没意思），一家生产地毯，他们参观的是地毯厂。

q20.explanationZh: 哥哥已经会开车，就说 Jenna 可以代替他去（he said I could take his place）。B 门票是父母送给哥哥的生日礼物；A 是她以后推荐给朋友，不是朋友推荐给她。

q21.explanationZh: 那天来开车的只有她、两个同龄女孩和两个大一点的青少年，这和她预想的不一样（not what I’d expected）。A 她到了之后才知道教练当过赛车手；C 她没对车失望，只是可惜不能马上上车。

q22.explanationZh: 看安全视频时她意识到自己根本不会开车，有点紧张（I was slightly anxious）。B 她从没想过放弃，想放弃的是另一个男孩；C 上赛道前本来就有练习课。

q23.explanationZh: 教练一直叫她刹车，而她想加速，这让她很烦（very annoying）。A 她只是听说有一款以这条赛道为原型的游戏；C 车是自动挡，不用操心很多操纵装置。

q24.explanationZh: 她开完车后累得筋疲力尽（completely exhausted），这是唯一让她不满的地方。B 她只说开了大约十分钟；C 车很有劲正是她想去的原因。

q25.explanationZh: 如果还有下次，她会尽量记住接下来是什么路段，好为弯道或直道做准备。A 她觉得没有很多问题要问；B 她说得到的指导已经让她明白了所有驾驶技巧。

content.v: Test Three. There are four parts to the test. You will hear each part twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now, because you must not speak during the test.
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
One. What has the boy lost?
Are you ready to leave? We don’t want to miss the flight.
I won’t be long.
What’s wrong? Have you lost your passport?
Dad’s looking after it. I’m trying to close my case. I can’t do it without the key, but I’ve no idea where it is.
I think I’ve got a spare one. Let me go and have a look.
Thanks. I need to put my sunglasses in first. Actually I want to buy some new ones, but I’ll take these in case I can’t find any I like.
Two. Which painting won first prize in the competition?
Did you see which painting came first in the ‘Natural World’ art competition?
Yeah. But why? It was just a picture of the Earth from space, and didn’t have anything special about it. There were so many others which were just brilliant.
I know. I thought that painting of the desert would definitely win first prize. So beautiful!
You’re joking! There was hardly anything in it! For me, the jungle picture with all the plants and insects deserved to win: it showed just how amazing rainforests can be.
Three. Which activity is available at the sports centre next Saturday?

Thanks for calling City Sports Centre. Here’s some information about our programme this weekend. The pool will be closed to the public because of a competition on Saturday, but swimmers can use it at all other times. We’ve replaced our old table tennis tables, and from now on, you can book the new ones. The tennis courts are fully booked. Please call 349826 if you wish to play. We will then let you know if anyone has cancelled their reservation. We hope to see you at the centre this weekend.
Four. What does the girl need to buy?
Have you got everything you need for the new term?
I just need to get a new file for my notes.
But they give us them on the first day at school, don’t they?
Oh, do they? That’s good news. I got all my books and pens at the start of the holidays, so there’s no need to get anything else, apart from a ruler to replace the one I broke.
Oh well, I don’t think that’ll be very expensive. I’ll come with you if you like.
Five. Where did the boy leave his sports bag?

Mum, it’s me. I’ve got football practice after school but I’ve forgotten my football kit. It’s in my sports bag, but there’s no need to look in my bedroom. I remember getting my clean kit out of the cupboard and putting it in the bag. Then I took it into the bathroom when I went for a shower, but I forgot to pick it up afterwards. Oh, and could you bring my scarf? It’s in the hall by the front door. I think I’ll need it today. Thanks so much.
Six. Where are the boy and girl going on Saturday?
Are you still okay for going to the zoo on Saturday?
Oh, haven’t you heard? It’s closed all weekend while they move the animals to new areas in the zoo.
What? I was looking forward to that.
I’d be happy to go to the cinema again. Or we could go horse-riding?
I’m not sure I can afford that.
Well, that movie about the woman who rescues animals is on in town all week. We could see that.
Fine. Let’s do that. More fun than staying at home.
Seven. Which job is the new class project about?

Hi Jack. Hope you’re feeling better. I just wanted to let you know what our new class project’s about. Today a lecturer from the university came and gave us a talk about careers. He spoke about lots of jobs ... from being a teacher to a photographer. The most interesting one, though, was an astronaut. Anyway, Mr Wood wants us to do some research on this now. We have to find some photos that show what the work involves and find an interview with one too. I’ll tell you more later.
That is the end of Part One.
Now look at Part Two. For each question, choose the correct answer.
Eight. You will hear a brother and sister talking about a school trip to a museum.
Are you looking forward to the school trip tomorrow?
Well, I’ve been to that museum several times with Mum and Dad so it’s not as if I’m going to see all the exhibitions for the first time.
True, but it’ll be nice to spend time with your classmates away from school.
Yeah, and it’ll be fun to chat to some of my friends from other classes on the coach.
How’s your foot now, by the way?
Much better, luckily. When I hurt it the other day, I thought I wouldn’t be able to go on this trip.
Yeah, that’d be awful!
Nine. You will hear a boy telling his friend about his new phone.
Have you seen my new phone?
Wow! Is that the one that’s got a really high quality camera?

That’s what all the reviews said, and it’s the main reason I chose this model. It’s totally brilliant. But the problem is I take so many pictures and videos that I’m using all the memory. It’d be better if it had more.
Well, I think it looks really cool – light and slim and I love the silver grey colour!
Yeah, but that isn’t the sort of thing I care about – a phone that looks stylish or fashionable.
Ten. You will hear two friends talking about a thunderstorm the day before.
Did you see that thunderstorm yesterday afternoon? The lightning was amazing.
I was walking home from football practice when the rain started!
It was really heavy.

Yeah. When it began I’d just left the sports centre, so I was able to go back and take cover inside. I called my mum to say I’d be home late. Anyway, I met a friend who was still there so we just chatted and waited till it was over. Shame I missed seeing the lightning though. I heard it was spectacular.
So you didn’t get wet?
No, after it stopped I just walked home.
Eleven. You will hear a boy telling a friend about his new bike.
Is that a new bike you’ve got there?
Yes, it’s great, isn’t it? I’m really proud of it. I’ve been on a few bike rides already, but I’ll have to do a lot more than that if I want to improve my fitness levels!
You’ll save money too, because you won’t need to get the bus to school anymore.
That’s true, and now I don’t have to ask Mum for a lift whenever I want to go anywhere. That’s what makes the biggest difference for me. I hated having to use public transport all the time too.
Twelve. You will hear two friends talking about a film they have seen together.
That’s the first film I’ve seen with an interval. I thought they only had them in plays and shows.
They sometimes have them in long films like that one. It gave me the chance to try and understand what was going on – there were so many characters!
It was hard to work out what was happening, and the break made me forget who was who! The soundtrack didn’t really go with the action in the film either.
They kept playing the same song, but it added to the atmosphere. I don’t know why people said the film was good though.
Thirteen. You will hear two friends talking about a football club they play for.
Are you going to football at the club tomorrow?
Yeah. We’ll get to wear the new purple team shirt.
I’m glad they changed it from grey. Such a boring colour.
They’ve improved other things at the club too.
Yeah. It’ll be our first time on that new pitch. I wonder if it’ll be better – not playing on grass anymore.
Even our coach seems happy about it. Shame he rarely lets us play for fun though. Training’s always so hard.
It’s all about how to win matches. Maybe the new pitch and team shirt will make him smile for once.
That is the end of Part Two.
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one or two words or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 14 to 19 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear a boy giving a class presentation about a two-day trip he went on to a place called Sidelli.

On holiday, I went to a place called Sidelli with my family. It was really interesting and we spent two days there. On the first morning, we visited a theatre. It was built two thousand years ago beside the sea and people used to watch plays there in the open air. There used to be an old fishing village nearby. After that, we had a guided tour. Rather than go to the old palace, which is full of tourists, our guide took us up a hill and showed us around what’s left of a library. Most of it had fallen down, but it still had a fantastic atmosphere. I tried to imagine it full of old books, long ago in the past. We then took a bus into the countryside for lunch, and we ate next to a waterfall. Afterwards, we took a walk from there to a lake. It was dark green and full of loads of different kinds of fish. Then we walked down into a place called Flower Valley. There were so many different types of plants, but there were lots of insects too. Maybe they should call it Mosquito Valley instead! Anyway, it was amazing. On the morning of the second day there was a choice of activities to do in the sea. Everyone chose diving, but you could also do water-skiing. We were provided with all the necessary equipment and had such a good time. In the afternoon, we could choose to go on one of two different factory tours. One factory made pots and plates, which sounded dull to me, and one produced carpets. That was the one we went on. There were lots of traditional designs, all made by local people. It was really interesting. That was the last thing we did that day!
That is the end of Part Three.
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Look at questions 20 to 25 now. You have 45 seconds.
You will hear an interview with a girl called Jenna who went on a driving experience day for teenagers at a race track.
Jenna, you went on a driving experience day for teenagers at a race track recently. Why?

Well, people often think driving fast cars is for boys. My parents bought my brother a ticket for his birthday. I was so jealous and, as he already drives a car, he said I could take his place. I’d definitely recommend it – my best friend thought it sounded cool so she’s going to go too.
How did you feel when you arrived at the race track?

I waited in reception till everyone who was driving that day arrived – a couple of girls my age and two older teenagers – that was it – not what I’d expected, but I guess very few people knew about it. I thought I’d get in a car straight away but there was stuff to do first, which was a pity! My instructor was cool, though – he said he used to be a racing driver.
What did you have to do before driving?

We had to watch a video about staying safe. That’s when I realised I had no idea how to drive! I was slightly anxious, but I never considered not doing it, like one boy. We were told we’d have a practice session to get used to the car before going out on the track, which I was glad about.
How did you feel out on the track?

Brilliant! The car was automatic so I didn’t have to worry about using lots of controls. It was like those racing computer games – you can’t see what’s coming next. I’ve heard there’s a game based on that race track, actually. The instructor was sitting right next to me and kept telling me to brake when I wanted to speed up – very annoying!
Were you happy about everything else?

Well, yes and no. I knew the car would be super-powerful – that’s why I went. I drove for around ten minutes. It seemed much longer cos you concentrate so hard. The only thing was that I was completely exhausted when I finished, just from driving for such a short time!
What would you do differently next time?

If there is a next time, I’d probably do my best to learn what comes next as I was driving, so I’d be ready for a corner or a straight bit or whatever. The instructions I was given helped me to understand all the special driving techniques, so I didn’t feel I had loads of questions I needed to ask.
Thanks, Jenna.
That is the end of Part Four.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
You have one more minute.
That is the end of the test.
